question_summary: Conflict between Foundation Plan S-101 and Structural General Notes S-001 regarding column baseplate reinforcement (dowel spacing); after initial resolution, field asked whether the #6 dowel at 12" o.c. direction applies to all column baseplates on the level, not just the one referenced.
deadline_text: within two business days ahead of the scheduled pour
routing_rationale: As a document discrepancy involving structural reinforcement details, it is routed to the Structural Engineer, the design professional of record for this discipline.
